story: Day four hundred and forty eight is a signpost, not a finish. This is the culmination of four hundred and forty eight ordinary decisions. Three thousand words is a testament to showing up, not to talent. It is gratifying to read a page now and forget it is not your first language. Hardwon skill is the only kind that stays. Unwavering habits beat brilliant beginnings every single time. You are standing in a doorway that is already open. From here the road will beckon and it is yours to follow. Given use, a language will flourish; given silence, it will fade. Delve into books, films and conversations that are slightly too hard. Stay resolute on the days when nothing feels like progress. The world you can now read in English is boundless.
